comment: Two faults are provable in the source. The column offset line reads params[P_OFFSET + 1] inside the loop over all four columns, so only the second offset knob has any effect and it applies to all four outputs. And the Step CV jack, input 3, is declared and drawn but its index never appears in process(), so only the button beside it fires the divider randomiser. The maker's tooltips for the third and fourth column knobs both read Group 2.
